pages.description: Smiling with raised fists, chibi Tanjiro Kamado from Demon Slayer wears hanafuda earrings and a checkered haori surrounded by small floating hearts in this printable coloring page.

pages.description: Tanjiro Kamado holds his Nichirin sword in this printable coloring page, wearing his checkered haori, rectangular earrings, and wrapped shin guards on a rocky path. The diagonal blade crosses the lower half of the coloring sheet, while large clothing panels contrast with smaller squares, hair strands, and the sword's detailed guard.

pages.title: Tanjiro Using Water Breathing with a Sweeping Wave Around His Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro using Water Breathing, gripping his sword with both hands as a sweeping wave curls around his checkered haori and raised blade. Droplets and curling foam create many narrow shapes on the coloring sheet, with a waterfall, scattered rocks, and trees completing the river setting.

pages.title: Tanjiro Creating a Water Dragon with Constant Flux on Mount Natagumo Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro creates a Water Breathing dragon with Constant Flux on Mount Natagumo in this printable coloring page, crouching beneath its open jaws among tall trees. pages.title: Tanjiro Performing Sun Breathing Hinokami Kagura with Flames Around His Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Tanjiro performing Sun Breathing Hinokami Kagura, with looping flames surrounding his sword, checkered haori, and wide fighting stance beside a wooden fence. The flame tips form pointed shapes around the figure, while his uniform and trousers provide larger spaces within the detailed action coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chibi Tanjiro Carrying Nezuko in Her Wooden Box Along a Forest Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Tanjiro carries Nezuko in her wooden box along a forest path in this printable coloring page, smiling as she peeks over its reinforced rim. His hands hold the shoulder straps, and a sheathed sword hangs at his waist. Rounded faces, checkered sleeves, and leafy borders give the coloring sheet varied shapes.

pages.title: Tanjiro Wearing His Fox Mask Beneath the Wisteria at Final Selection Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro wears his fox mask beneath hanging wisteria at Final Selection in this printable coloring page, standing with a sheathed sword beside a rope-lined stone path. The mask's pointed ears and curved markings stand out against his checked haori, while cascading flower clusters create smaller repeated sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro and Nezuko Resting Beside Her Wooden Box Under a Wisteria Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro and Nezuko resting beneath a wisteria tree, seated beside her wooden box with mountains and a fence behind them. Tanjiro's checked haori contrasts with Nezuko's geometric kimono, and hanging blossom clusters frame their faces. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing folds with fine floral and fabric details.

pages.title: Tanjiro and Kanao Playing the Reflex Cup Game at the Butterfly Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro and Kanao play the reflex cup game at the Butterfly Mansion in this printable coloring page, reaching toward two cups on a low wooden table. Open sliding doors reveal a courtyard beyond them. Their seated poses, Kanao's butterfly hair ornament, and the straight floor and window lines organize the coloring sheet into distinct sections.

pages.title: Tanjiro and Rengoku Sharing Bento Boxes Aboard the Mugen Train Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro and Rengoku sharing bento boxes aboard the Mugen Train, holding chopsticks while seated together beneath the carriage's curved ceiling. Rengoku's flame-edged cloak and leg coverings contrast with Tanjiro's checked haori. The compartmented meals add small food shapes to a coloring sheet filled with larger clothing areas.

pages.title: Tanjiro and Giyu Confronting Akaza in the Infinity Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro and Giyu confront Akaza inside the Infinity Castle in this printable coloring page, drawing their swords across a wooden platform beneath stacked balconies and beams. Akaza faces them from the foreground with striped markings on his back and arms. The coloring sheet pairs patterned clothing with a detailed network of architectural lines.

pages.title: Demon King Tanjiro with Facial Flame Markings and a Torn Uniform in the Ruined City Coloring Page
pages.description: Demon King Tanjiro stands in a ruined city in this printable coloring page, showing facial flame markings, pointed teeth, and a torn uniform among collapsed buildings. His spread feet and lowered hands center the composition, with a large moon above the rubble. Jagged fabric edges and broken timbers add detailed shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Carrying a Charcoal Basket Down the Snowy Mountain Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro carries a charcoal basket down a snowy mountain in this printable coloring page, gripping rope shoulder straps and wearing a scarf over his checked haori. A small house, snow-covered trees, and distant peaks line the trail. Basket weaving and scarf fringe add fine sections beside the open snowbanks on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Young Tanjiro Watching Tanjuro Perform the Hinokami Kagura Dance Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Tanjiro watches Tanjuro perform the Hinokami Kagura dance in this printable coloring page, standing beside flaming torches as snow falls around their family home. Tanjuro raises a bell wand with zigzag streamers and extends his other arm. Flowing sleeves and repeated checks form the central patterns on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Carrying Nezuko on His Back Through the Snowy Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro carrying Nezuko on his back through a snowy forest, supporting her legs as she rests her hands on his shoulders. Her long hair flows beside a patterned kimono, and snowflakes fill the space between tall trunks. Broad snowbanks frame the pair on this winter coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Protecting Nezuko From Giyu on the Snowy Mountain Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro protects Nezuko from Giyu on a snowy mountain in this printable coloring page, extending one hand while holding his sword at his other side. Nezuko stands behind him, and Giyu faces them with a lowered blade. The coloring sheet includes geometric haori patterns, snow-covered trees, and a distant mountain peak.

pages.title: Tanjiro Hugging Urokodaki and Nezuko After Returning From Final Selection Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro hugging Urokodaki and Nezuko after returning from Final Selection, with all three gathered outside a wooden cabin beneath leafy trees. Urokodaki's long-nosed mask rises above their smiling faces, and his hand rests on Tanjiro's head. Checked, cloud, and geometric fabric patterns fill the family reunion coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Avoiding a Swinging Log Trap on Mount Sagiri Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro avoids a swinging log trap on Mount Sagiri in this printable coloring page, crouching beneath a rope-suspended trunk with his arms spread for balance. Curved motion lines follow the log through the trees. The coloring sheet combines the large cut end's growth rings with narrow rope twists and checks across his sleeves.

pages.title: Tanjiro Practicing Breathing Beneath a Waterfall on Mount Sagiri Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Tanjiro practicing breathing beneath a waterfall on Mount Sagiri, standing barefoot with closed eyes and his palms pressed together at chest height. Streams and droplets run over his loose training clothes, while rocks surround the pool. Long water contours alternate with small splash shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Sparring with Sabito Using Wooden Swords in a Forest Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro spars with Sabito using wooden swords in this printable coloring page, their crossed practice blades rising between them in a grassy forest clearing beneath tall trees. Both hold bent-knee stances, with checks on Tanjiro's haori and interlocking shapes on Sabito's. Sparse grass tufts leave open ground around the figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Learning Breathing Techniques From Makomo Beside the Giant Training Boulder Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro learning breathing techniques from Makomo beside the giant training boulder, where she gestures with one hand against her chest. A flower-decorated fox mask rests at the side of her head, and a thick rope circles the rock. Floral fabric and zigzag paper strips detail the forest coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Splitting the Giant Training Boulder with His Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro's boulder-splitting training is shown in this printable coloring page, with his sword lowered beside the giant rock's deep central divide and scattered fragments on the ground. His checkered haori and uniform buttons stand against the cracked stone surface. Broad boulder sections and small rubble pieces create contrasting areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Facing the Hand Demon Among the Trees of Mount Fujikasane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro facing the Hand Demon among Mount Fujikasane's trees, holding his sword across his body beneath the creature's many reaching arms. Smaller hands cover the demon's face and wrap around its torso. Tall trunks frame the encounter, leaving the detailed tangle of limbs central on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Choosing Ore for His First Nichirin Sword After Final Selection Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro chooses ore for his first Nichirin sword after Final Selection in this printable coloring page, reaching toward rough stones arranged on a wooden table. Wisteria hangs from the structure overhead, with mountains beyond a fence. The coloring sheet offers angular ore facets, repeated haori squares, and small blossom sections around the central figure.

pages.title: Tanjiro Receiving a Mission From His Kasugai Crow on a Mountain Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro receives a mission from his Kasugai crow on a mountain trail in this printable coloring page, looking toward its open beak while carrying Nezuko's box. The crow perches on a branch above his sheathed sword, with peaks behind them. Layered feathers, shoulder straps, and rocky path edges add distinct details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Inspecting His First Nichirin Sword with Haganezuka at Urokodaki's Cabin Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro inspects his first Nichirin sword with Haganezuka at Urokodaki's cabin in this printable coloring page, smiling while the masked swordsmith points toward the raised blade. Haganezuka wears a broad hat and a robe covered in sunburst motifs. These repeated patterns and the cabin's straight boards provide contrasting details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Battling the Swamp Demon at the Edge of a Dark Bog Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro battling the Swamp Demon at a bog's edge, raising his sword as a horned figure reaches from the water. Bare trees and broken stumps stand behind the creature's clawed hands. Tanjiro's wide stance fills the foreground of the coloring sheet, with reeds and ripples marking the shoreline.

pages.title: Tanjiro Discovering Muzan Among the Lanterns on the Streets of Asakusa Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro discovers Muzan among the lanterns on Asakusa's streets in this printable coloring page, holding a lowered sword while Muzan looks back beneath a brimmed hat. Wooden shopfronts and rows of hanging lanterns recede behind them. The coloring sheet contrasts Tanjiro's checked haori with Muzan's plain suit and the lanterns' rounded panels.

pages.title: Tanjiro and Nezuko Visiting Tamayo and Yushiro's Hidden Clinic Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Tanjiro and Nezuko visiting Tamayo and Yushiro's hidden clinic, seated together around a low table with four cups and a small box. Shelves hold bottles, books, a drawer cabinet, and a mortar. Tamayo's floral kimono supplies smaller patterned areas within the carefully outlined room on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Using Water Breathing Against Yahaba's Directional Arrows Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro uses Water Breathing against Yahaba's directional arrows in this printable coloring page, sweeping his sword through a curling stream beneath several large outlined arrowheads. Yahaba holds both palms forward, showing an eye on each hand. The action coloring sheet leaves a plain background around the water droplets, patterned haori, and layered robes.

pages.title: Tanjiro Reassuring Shoichi and Teruko Outside the Tsuzumi Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Tanjiro reassuring Shoichi and Teruko outside the Tsuzumi Mansion, crouching beside them with one hand resting on the boy's shoulder. The children stand close together before a wooden entrance, and Tanjiro's sword remains sheathed. Their faces and clothing form the main coloring areas, bordered by shrubs and doorway panels.

pages.title: Tanjiro Balancing in Kyogai's Rotating Room Among Floating Manuscripts Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanjiro balances in Kyogai's rotating room among floating manuscripts in this printable coloring page, bracing his sword as the drum-covered demon stands behind him. The coloring sheet mixes broad clothing folds with manuscript lines and circular drum rims.

pages.title: Tanjiro Stopping Inosuke From Attacking Nezuko's Wooden Box Coloring Page

Inosuke holds two notched swords at his sides, with shaggy fur around his waist. The plain background keeps the figures and box central on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Sharing a Rice Ball with Zenitsu Outside the Tsuzumi Mansion Coloring Page

Zenitsu reaches forward beneath his triangle-patterned haori, while Tanjiro holds another rice ball. Shrubs, rocks, and repeating roof tiles frame the seated pair on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro and Inosuke Searching the Spider Webs on Mount Natagumo Coloring Page

Large webs stretch across the upper corners, above Inosuke's boar mask and Tanjiro's checked haori. Narrow web sections and leafy undergrowth surround the larger figures on this forest coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro and Nezuko Combining Hinokami Kagura and Blood Demon Art Against Rui Coloring Page

pages.title: Tanjiro Recovering Under Shinobu's Care at the Butterfly Mansion Coloring Page

A flower vase rests on a nearby table, and an open door stands behind Shinobu. Blanket folds create large coloring areas alongside her butterfly-patterned sleeves and hair ornament.

pages.title: Tanjiro Blowing Into a Training Gourd Beside Aoi at the Butterfly Mansion Coloring Page

pages.title: Tanjiro Flipping Kanao's Coin in the Butterfly Mansion Garden Coloring Page

pages.title: Tanjiro Boarding the Mugen Train with Zenitsu and Inosuke at Night Coloring Page

pages.title: Tanjiro Embracing His Mother Outside the Snowy Family Home in His Mugen Train Dream Coloring Page

Her headscarf and waist bow contrast with his checked haori. Broad snowbanks leave open areas around the figures, while roof edges and tree branches supply finer details.

pages.title: Tanjiro Facing Enmu on the Roof of the Mugen Train Coloring Page

A moon and clouds hang above the curved carriage roof, and vents repeat along its length. Enmu's striped trousers add narrow sections beside the broader panels of Tanjiro's haori.

pages.title: Tanjiro Talking with Senjuro at the Rengoku Family Estate Coloring Page

Tanjiro gestures with an open hand while Senjuro rests his hands on his lap. A stone lantern, shrubs, and sliding wall panels frame the conversation on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tanjiro Disguised as Sumiko Carrying Boxes Through the Tokito House Coloring Page
